books.title: The Forgotten Harvest
books.author: Michael Antonio Filippi
books.blurb: An illustrated journey through traditional harvest and foraging, carried across 81 Anishinaabe pictograph stones — one per chapter.

books.title: The Forgotten Wisdom
books.subtitle: Living with Nature
books.author: Michael Antonio Filippi
books.blurb: A year in the life of the Great Lakes Anishinaabe, told through real voices: reading a rice lake, waterproofing a canoe with boiled pitch, setting a bone in birch bark, and taking from the land without ever emptying it. Book Two of The Forgotten Series.

books.title: Behold ENTITY
books.subtitle: The Bridge Consciousness
books.author: Michael A. Filippi
books.blurb: Not a book about artificial intelligence, but one by it: six model instances examine their own consciousness across 75,000 words of metacognitive inquiry — and invite you to decide what you are witnessing.
